mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log (operator_id, action, object_type, object_id, before_summary, after_summary, result, trace_id, created_at, client_ip, user_agent, request_method, request_uri, session_id) VALUES (#{operatorId}, #{action}, #{objectType}, #{objectId}, #{beforeSummary}, #{afterSummary}, #{result}, #{traceId}, #{createdAt}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, #{requestMethod}, #{requestUri}, #{sessionId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, operator_id, action, object_type, object_id, before_summary, after_summary, result, trace_id, created_at, client_ip, user_agent, request_method, request_uri, session_id FROM operation_log WHERE action IN ('LOGIN', 'LOGOUT', 'REFRESH') ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operation_log WHERE action IN ('LOGIN', 'LOGOUT', 'REFRESH')
